description: React component for rendering code output with support for images and file downloads in a code interpreter dashboard.

classes.name: CodeInterpreterOutput
classes.description: A React functional component that displays code execution results, including code snippets, images, and file download options.

methods.name: fetchImages
methods.description: Fetches images from container files API for annotations with image file types.

methods.name: handleDownload
methods.description: Fetches file content from container files API and initiates download for given annotations.
